examples: The masseuse was rubbing my back too softly for my liking, so I asked her to go harder.

quotes.text: He had married a lady well educated and softly nurtured, but not dowered with worldly wealth. […] They would give up ideas of gentle living, of soft raiment, and delicate feeding.

senses.definition: With subdued color; faded or misty with distance.

quotes.text: And they sat very still, the two of them, and looked out over that great, beautiful desert—away to the home mesa that they could see, softly blue, in the distance.
